name: Paublillo
description: Paublillo is a Colombian trick-taking game from Tolima. 2-8 players (best 6), 40-card Spanish deck. Three-card hands, betting; win at least two of three tricks. Trump 4 (monja) and 3 (paublillo) are special. 12 stones to win.

overview.description: Paublillo is a Colombian trick-taking game from Tolima. 2-8 players (best 6), 40-card Spanish deck. Three-card hands, betting; win at least two of three tricks. Trump 4 (monja) and 3 (paublillo) are special. 12 stones to win.

history.origins: Tolima department, Colombia. Mostly rural; farmers, fishermen. Little presence in IbaguÃ©; unknown in BogotÃ¡. Based on Felipe Sanchez Vidales.
history.cultural: Often played for beer. High-stakes can lead to violence; play for fun.
history.evolution: Format like Truco (3-card, 2-of-3 tricks) but different ranking and structure; separate origin.

setup.players: 2, 4, 6, or 8. Best 6. Teams of equal size; each player between two opponents.
setup.deck: 40-card Spanish: swords, batons, cups, coins. Ranks: Rey(12), Caballo(11), Sota(10), 7-2, As(1).
setup.dealing: Deal and play anticlockwise. One suit = trump per deal.

rules.objective: First team to 12 points. Each deal: 3-card hands, win at least 2 of 3 tricks.
rules.gameplay: Trump suit designated per deal. Trump ranking differs from plain suits. 4 of trumps = monja, 3 of trumps = paublillo (special names). Three tricks; need 2 to win the deal. Betting. Score with 12 stones (10 + 2 distinct).

strategy.intermediate: Monja and paublillo timing. Betting strategy.
tips: Structure similar to Truco but different mechanics.
Play for fun, not high stakes.

scoring.description: 12 stones. Two stones distinct. First to 12 wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Colombian 3-card trick game. Monja, paublillo. 12 to win.
